bot.pageIntro: Your channel's own bot: commands, timers, chat filters, channel points and song requests.
bot.pageIntroOther: You are managing the bot of {channel}. You see what your role on that channel allows.
bot.loadFailed: The bot settings could not be loaded.
bot.error.forbidden: Your role on this channel does not allow that.
bot.settings.title: Settings
bot.settings.intro: Turn the bot on, name it and choose what it does in your chat.
bot.settings.enabledHint: When it is off, it answers no commands and filters nothing.
bot.settings.noAccount: Its account is created the first time you turn it on.
bot.settings.created: The bot speaks in your chat as @{username}. It is a moderator of your channel.
bot.settings.displayNameHint: The name chat shows for the bot; up to {max} characters.
bot.settings.filterSpamHint: Removes messages that repeat one character over and over.
bot.settings.filterLinksHint: Removes links from viewers who are not subscribers.
bot.settings.filterCapsHint: Removes long messages written mostly in capitals.
bot.settings.timeoutHint: 0 removes the message without a timeout.
bot.settings.pointsEnabledHint: Viewers earn points while they watch and spend them on commands, votes and predictions. They have no cash value.
bot.settings.srEnabledHint: Viewers add a link with !sr. Links are only listed for you, never played or opened by the bot.
bot.settings.saveFailed: The bot settings could not be saved.
bot.settings.error.displayName: Enter a name of 1 to {max} characters.
bot.settings.error.pointsName: Enter a name of 1 to {max} characters.
bot.settings.error.timeout: Enter a whole number of seconds from 0 to {max}.
bot.settings.error.srMax: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
bot.command.title: Commands
bot.command.intro: What the bot answers when someone types !name in chat.
bot.command.formHint: The response can use the variables listed under the table.
bot.command.emptyHint: Add one, for example !socials with your links.
bot.command.name: Name
bot.command.nameHint: Typed after ! in chat: lowercase letters, digits and underscores, up to {max}.
bot.command.cooldownHint: Time between two uses, 0 to {max} seconds.
bot.command.removeBody: The bot stops answering it. Its use count is lost.
bot.command.removeFailed: The command could not be removed.
bot.command.error.name: Use 1 to {max} lowercase letters, digits or underscores.
bot.command.error.builtin: That name belongs to a built-in command (!points, !sr, !commands).
bot.command.error.alias: Each other name uses lowercase letters, digits or underscores.
bot.command.error.response: Enter a response of 1 to {max} characters.
bot.command.error.cooldown: Enter a whole number of seconds from 0 to {max}.
bot.command.error.cost: Enter a whole number of points, 0 or more.
bot.command.error.exists: !{name} already exists. Edit it from the table instead.

bot.command.error.limit: This channel has the most commands it can have. Remove one first.
bot.command.error.invalid: The command was refused. Check the name and the other names.
bot.command.error.failed: The command could not be saved.
bot.variables.help.title: Variables you can use in a response
bot.variables.help.user: the name of whoever used the command
bot.variables.help.touser: the first word after the command, without @ (else the caller)
bot.variables.help.count: how many times the command has been used, this time included
bot.variables.help.uptime: how long you have been live
bot.variables.help.pointsName: what your channel calls its points
bot.variables.help.var: the value of your variable called name (set it below)

bot.timer.intro: Messages the bot posts on a schedule, only while chat is active.
bot.timer.formHint: The bot posts after both the time and the chat lines have gone by.
bot.timer.name: Name
bot.timer.minLinesHint: At least 1: a timer never talks to an empty room.

bot.variable.intro: Values your commands and timers can show, such as your schedule.

bot.sr.intro: Links viewers asked for with !sr. Nothing is played or opened for you: mark each one when you are done.
